reviews.text:
We've had several consultations with both Dr. Riou and Dr. Miltchaliev, and they are always gentle with our cats and patient with us. They really take the time to explain and answer all our questions clearly and concisely.

Julie, the assistant, is always very kind and welcoming. We highly recommend them!

I wanted to share my very positive experience at this veterinary clinic.

I've been taking my cat there for four years, and recently adopted a second one from the shelter. Dr. Riou and Dr. Miltchaliev have always been very gentle, attentive, and proactive in ensuring the well-being of my animals. Personally, I've always felt comfortable and reassured at this clinic. When my first cat got old and sick, I was very worried, and despite my numerous calls and visits, they always took the time to address my concerns. Eventually, I had to make the difficult decision to put him down. They offered me an appointment during the day, and the procedure was carried out gently; they gave me time to say goodbye. It was a difficult time, but thanks to them, it was much easier to bear. A huge thank you!

Hello,
Thank you for your rating and your trust.
Have a lovely day,
The Veterinary Clinic Team.

Hello 🤗
Thank you so much for your feedback! We're always happy to hear from you if you'd like to share any suggestions for improving our services to ensure your complete satisfaction.
Take care of yourself and your pet! 🐾 The Mon Véto Lyon Saxe Team
Excellent welcome. But the price of the leukemia vaccination is too high.

A fantastic first experience with Dr. Miltchaliev and her assistant, Marine. My dog ​​is very difficult and aggressive with vets, but the doctor and her assistant were gentle and patient, and everything went very well. They are kind and non-judgmental. I highly recommend them!
A very humane team and veterinarian whom I thank very much for his words, his time and his care.

If you're looking for an exceptional veterinary clinic, go there!

To give you some background, my princess (a 16-year-old cat at the time) was vomiting. I had just moved to the Guillotière neighborhood and was looking for an emergency vet clinic, having thoroughly checked Google reviews because I'd had bad experiences when I lived with my parents. Anyway, I had an appointment with Dr. Miltchaliev. Bella had pyometra.
Thanks to his diagnosis and quick response, the vets managed to save her life (no exaggeration), and Bella will be celebrating her 18th birthday in less than a month 😍. The follow-up care was perfect. The clinic was always available to answer our questions. The veterinary assistants at reception are lovely, kind, and caring.

I feel like my comment is a bit rambling, but just so you know, for those reading this, remember one thing: you can go to this veterinary clinic with your eyes closed; you'll be cared for by absolutely wonderful professionals! 😊
I highly recommend Dr. Coste. He is a very attentive listener and doesn't push himself unnecessarily with treatments. He is a very, very humane person.

First visit to the vet clinic, and I'm completely satisfied.

I got an appointment quickly. Despite a slight delay, my dog ​​and I were very well received. Dr. Riou was very attentive, efficient, and professional. You can tell he takes the time to properly care for the animals.
An excellent first experience. Thank you to the whole team for their welcome, kindness, and professionalism!

We always receive a warm welcome at the veterinary clinic. The receptionist is very kind and takes excellent care of us on-site. The veterinarians take the time to explain what they are going to do for our pet, and we leave feeling educated about best practices for our animal's well-being.
I highly recommend them!

First visit today after moving to the neighborhood; I'm very happy with my appointment. The staff was punctual, smiling, and pleasant. The vet who saw me was very patient and helpful, explaining everything in detail and taking excellent care of my pet, gently, despite my cat's strong personality. Prices are quite standard for a city vet, with the quality of care to match. I highly recommend them!
A caring, smiling and very professional team!
First time for my cat: neutering, microchipping, and vaccination. Fair price, excellent, nothing to complain about.

I am extremely disappointed with the Saxe Gambetta veterinary clinic. As a regular client, I have always taken care of my cat and always paid for the requested treatments. Today, my cat was urinating a lot of blood, and I was very worried. I called hoping to find a solution or at least a sympathetic ear.

Instead, I was given a quote completely beyond my means, with no real attempt to adapt or understand the situation. When I explained that it was financially difficult for me and asked if there was a payment plan or some minimal solution to alleviate my cat's suffering, the response was cold and very inhumane. I was told, "It's the same for humans, but we have health insurance cards."

I found this remark extremely inappropriate and hurtful, especially when you call in a panic because your pet is suffering and urinating blood. I completely understand that a clinic has expenses and that treatment costs money, but there's a way to speak to people. A little empathy and consideration would have been appreciated. I will never return and I advise you against going to this clinic.

I leave with the feeling that I was judged for my financial difficulties rather than helped as a loyal customer worried about my pet and hoping my cat would get better, since you clearly don't care.

A huge thank you again to Dr. Riou for his efficiency, warm welcome, and professionalism at the veterinary clinic located at 142 Avenue Maréchal de Saxe.

It's so valuable!

Our animals are treated with the utmost care.

Thank you!!

Caroline Fillardet
Great clinic, the team is fantastic. Thanks again :)
A welcoming and caring practice, both with us and our pet. I highly recommend it.

Dr. Coste is exceptional!

I don't know a better veterinarian—professional, efficient, and empathetic.

A huge thank you!!

Congratulations on your outstanding skills and your compassion.

An excellent veterinary clinic, always a warm welcome, they take the time to assess each situation. They have always taken great care of our animals: dogs and cats, for the past 14 years!

Unlike other clinics, they don't push unnecessary "sales" by prescribing unnecessary tests!
In short, I highly recommend them!
A warm and welcoming reception. Simple and effective advice. Perfect.
Expensive consultation for a vaccine
The practitioner was excellent, very attentive, and the staff were very kind!

Thank you to the entire team, and especially to Dr. Riou, for accompanying my brother Newton on his final journey.
RIP
Fantastic team, very attentive, patient, and caring. I highly recommend them!

This veterinary clinic is fantastic; the entire team is very welcoming, helpful, and offers excellent advice. Dr. Coste, who saw us, was very gentle and careful with our pet, and demonstrated great patience in explaining any treatments and the important things to monitor in his daily life. A trustworthy team to care for and better understand your animals!
A very pleasant welcome and Dr. Coste is a model of kindness and teaching skills 🐈‍⬛ …
Hello Ms. Ossart, thank you for this review, it means a lot to us. Sincerely,
Julie clearly doesn't know how to treat her clients… she's dismissive and unpleasant! I was going to have to change vets after moving, and I definitely won't be going there…
The team was very welcoming and helpful, and the vet was very gentle and caring with the animals. Good advice and excellent service!

I've been a loyal patient at this practice for over 20 years and I'm truly very happy with them. Doctors Coste, Riou, and now Dr. Miltchaliev are very caring and take the time to explain the necessary treatment when needed. I'm very grateful to the entire team.
Our dog was seen as an emergency at this veterinary clinic. The welcome was very kind and the care was excellent.

So glad I found you to care for my Blacky 🐕
You treated his skin condition, and thanks to your care, he lived to be 13 years and 3 months old. If I ever had to have him euthanized, depending on his health, I really wanted to do it at your clinic with your very kind and competent veterinarians and assistants, even in difficult times...
N. THOMAS

Hello Bastien,
Thank you for taking the time to leave us a positive review!
Have a good day!

I consulted Caroline Miltchaliev for an ear infection and conjunctivitis in my cat. She was very alarming about the state of his heart, telling me he "could die at any moment" and suggesting an echocardiogram costing €200. Ultimately, there was no problem with his heart. In total, three consultations and €600 spent, and my cat still has the ear infection and conjunctivitis despite the treatment and the follow-up visit during which "it's very encouraging and he'll be cured in three days." Avoid her at all costs.
Hello Mr. Gorjux, we thank you for your loyalty and your kind appreciation.
The team is great. Mimi is good. Glad to have them.
Hello Mr. Brunet, thank you for taking the time to leave us this kind review. We look forward to working with you again.
Hello Ms. Chéron, thank you for leaving us this kind review.
Thank you, Mr. Echivard, for taking the time to leave us this wonderful review. We look forward to hearing from you!

€26 for a box of medication that sells for €10 at the pharmacy... I was quite bitter realizing this as I left the doctor's office!

In response to your message: you must have the wrong client, as I did not request a refund. For me, the matter ended with the above observation.

A very warm welcome, a very professional veterinarian.
He took the time to explain, inform, and advise us.
I recommend him without hesitation for a kitten like my case!
A huge thank you to Dr. Riou and his assistants. This veterinarian is exceptionally gentle and has taken great care of our cats every time we've visited. I highly recommend him!
Hello Ms. Lallier, Thank you for taking the time to leave us such a lovely review.
Hello, Thank you for your positive feedback.
A lovely and helpful team of professionals!
The vet is very kind; he explains the origin and causes of the problems very well, and is very patient and informative. The prices are high, but that's not surprising.

I took my pets, Buddy and Boo, to this clinic for 10 years. I had complete confidence in the entire team: Dr. Riou, Dr. Coste, and the veterinary assistants, Julie and Magali. They are all very friendly, both with people and animals, and very professional.

They even helped me find a home for a little kitten I found in the street.
I no longer live in Lyon, so I've changed veterinary clinics, but I wanted to thank you for everything you did for my animals.
Hello Mr. Prost, Thank you for leaving us such a high-star rating.
Very pleasant, I highly recommend..
A top-quality veterinary center. The entire team, from the veterinary assistants to the doctors, is very caring and dedicated to the well-being of the animals they see. I highly recommend them!
Booking the appointment online and the reception at the office went very smoothly. Dr. Riou was very kind and helpful during Spirit's vaccination appointment. I recommend the practice.
Thank you for evaluating our clinic.
Thank you for leaving us this lovely review.
Hello Ms. Bainvel, thank you for your positive feedback.

I thank all the helpful staff. In addition to the service, they helped me as a person who does not speak French.  I recommend it to everyone, they treat both animals and their owners with care here ❤️
Thank you for your kind review.
Thank you Mr. Bouat for your evaluation.
Great vet, attentive and caring 😽 …
